name: Mize
description: Logs every job application and shows which employers actually reply.
notes: Mize looks like Mize for iPhone now: Figtree, the warm colours, moving stickers and floating trays.
It uses the whole window: the list beside the open job, Sent as a table with cards over it, Settings in three columns.
Sent's plus logs a saved job in three clicks, and sign-in keeps its globe with Sign in with Apple.
